command.description: One shell command, run in the developer's login shell from their home folder on their Mac, such as "git -C ~/code/app status", "ls ~/code", or "node --version".

description.description: What the command is for, in plain English for the developer reading along: 3 to 8 words, sentence case, no trailing period, such as "Run the unit tests" or "Find where invites are sent".

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds before the command is killed; 60 when left out, at most 480. Ask for longer only for a command that needs it, such as a test suite or a build.
